item.goods_001.description: Physical charcoal cargo from wood burners, used for forge fuel. Handling: keep covered and separate from sparks. Failure: rain spoils heat; fire consumes the lot. Material behavior: burns hot and produces smoke. Contract use: restores fuel work after a route shortage. Equipment use: feeds controlled fires and powder preparation. Buyers: smiths, kiln crews.

item.goods_002.description: Physical grain cargo from field farms, used for daily bread. Handling: keep dry and raised above bilge water. Failure: water swells sacks; fire destroys food. Material behavior: wet sacks gain condition loss and obstruct cargo space. Contract use: settles food shortages and seed claims. Equipment use: provisions expedition rest and cooking. Buyers: mill fellowships, travelling households.

item.goods_003.description: Physical ironwork cargo from riverside smiths, used for mill and vessel repair. Handling: lash rigid cases against shifting cargo. Failure: salt and lime abrade fittings; impact bends them. Material behavior: adds structural mass and corrodes in slurry. Contract use: repairs gates, bridges and Jomon. Equipment use: supplies reinforcement and workshop fittings. Buyers: millwrights, bridge companies.

item.goods_004.description: Physical lime cargo from lime burners, used for mortar and fields. Handling: keep sealed, dry and away from skin. Failure: water makes a caustic slurry; spill contaminates cloth. Material behavior: wet lime raises abrasive smoke and coating. Contract use: repairs masonry and disputed field soil. Equipment use: prepares counted lime pots and protective wash. Buyers: mortar crews, field courts.

item.goods_005.description: Physical paper cargo from rag mills, used for contracts and accounts. Handling: carry flat in a waxed case. Failure: water erases accounts; fire removes evidence. Material behavior: burns quickly and absorbs water. Contract use: provides witnessed terms and replacement records. Equipment use: supports negotiation when seals are absent. Buyers: factors, river authorities.

item.goods_006.description: Physical salt fish cargo from coast smokehouses, used for stored food. Handling: keep sealed and shaded from bilge heat. Failure: broken seals spoil provisions; water weakens wrapping. Material behavior: salt residue contaminates wet cargo. Contract use: feeds isolated workers during route closure. Equipment use: extends voyage provisions without cooking. Buyers: inland households, coppice camps.

item.goods_007.description: Physical timber cargo from managed woods, used for building and braces. Handling: brace long pieces and keep bindings sound. Failure: fire spreads; saturation adds load; impact splits support. Material behavior: floats, burns and serves as load-bearing support. Contract use: repairs crossings, sheds and flood banks. Equipment use: provides braces, hafts and hull repair. Buyers: shipwrights, raised-bank companies.

item.goods_008.description: Physical wool cargo from upland folds, used for cloth and insulation. Handling: bundle dry and ventilate after spray. Failure: water adds weight; sparks smoulder in packed cloth. Material behavior: insulates when dry and absorbs floodwater. Contract use: supplies cold shelters and seasonal obligations. Equipment use: lines armour and protects winter rigging. Buyers: winter pilots, armour workers.
